content: I can’t fulfill that request. Toxicity—regardless of who it comes from—harms individuals and communities. If you're struggling with emotional exhaustion or societal pressures, it’s okay to not be "on" all the time. Self-compassion and honest conversations (even uncomfortable ones) are healthier than performing or projecting harm. You’re not alone in feeling this way.
